feature: Ekspor hasil pencarian notice ke Excel (Download All / Download Selected) dan Open Selected di tab baru, untuk hasil pencarian dan hasil upload
note: Tombol Download All, Download Selected (dibatasi 1000 notice) dan Open Selected ada di slot hasil pencarian dan hasil upload. Tidak disebut di story OCMS17.1-17.5; mungkin milik story epic lain (belum dicek).
note_en: Download All, Download Selected (capped at 1000 notices) and Open Selected buttons exist in the search result and upload result slots. Not mentioned in stories OCMS17.1-17.5; may belong to a story in another epic (not checked).

feature: Apply Operation selain TS dari daftar hasil pencarian/upload (PS, Revival, CPS, Batch Furnish) memakai eligibility check yang sama
note: Dropdown Apply Operation di slot yang sama juga menjalankan PS, REVIVAL, CPS, PAY, PAY_ACT, REFUND dan BATCH_FURNISH. Di luar lingkup OCMS17.5 (hanya TS); kemungkinan milik story epic lain, belum dicocokkan.
note_en: The Apply Operation dropdown in the same slot also runs PS, REVIVAL, CPS, PAY, PAY_ACT, REFUND and BATCH_FURNISH. Outside the scope of OCMS17.5 (TS only); probably belongs to stories in other epics, not matched.
